description: Curated assistant questions that are reliable for live demos. Each carries a reference SQL used by engine tests (guard + real-schema execution) and by scripts/smoke/assistant_questions.mjs. The suggested_prompts in assistant_capabilities.json must come from this list.

questions.prompt: How many encounters resulted in a readmission within 30 days?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN readmitted = '<30' THEN encounter_id END) AS readmissions_within_30_days FROM hospital_readmissions

questions.prompt: What is the average time in hospital across all encounters?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(time_in_hospital), 2) AS avg_days FROM hospital_readmissions

questions.prompt: How many encounters are in each readmitted category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT readmitted, COUNT(encounter_id) AS encounters FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY readmitted ORDER BY readmitted

questions.prompt: Which race has the most lab procedures?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT race, SUM(num_lab_procedures) AS total_lab_procedures, ROUND(AVG(num_lab_procedures), 2) AS average_per_encounter FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY race ORDER BY total_lab_procedures DESC LIMIT 1

questions.prompt: What is the 30-day readmission rate by age bracket?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT age, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN readmitted = '<30' THEN encounter_id END) / COUNT(encounter_id), 1) AS readmission_rate_percent FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY age ORDER BY age

questions.prompt: Compare the 30-day readmission rate by insulin status
questions.expected_sql: SELECT insulin, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN readmitted = '<30' THEN encounter_id END) / COUNT(encounter_id), 1) AS readmission_rate_percent FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY insulin ORDER BY insulin

questions.prompt: What is the 30-day readmission rate by HbA1c test result?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT a1cresult, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN readmitted = '<30' THEN encounter_id END) / COUNT(encounter_id), 1) AS readmission_rate_percent FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY a1cresult ORDER BY a1cresult

questions.prompt: What is the average length of stay by admission type?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT admission_type_id, ROUND(AVG(time_in_hospital), 2) AS avg_days FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY admission_type_id ORDER BY admission_type_id

questions.prompt: How many encounters were discharged to each disposition category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT discharge_disposition_id, COUNT(encounter_id) AS encounters FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY discharge_disposition_id ORDER BY encounters DESC LIMIT 50

questions.prompt: What is the 30-day readmission rate by number of prior inpatient visits?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT number_inpatient, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN readmitted = '<30' THEN encounter_id END) / COUNT(encounter_id), 1) AS readmission_rate_percent FROM hospital_readmissions GROUP BY number_inpatient ORDER BY number_inpatient LIMIT 50

questions.prompt: What is the average predicted readmission risk by age group?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT age, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(predicted_readmission_risk), 1) AS avg_risk_percent FROM hospital_readmissions WHERE predicted_readmission_risk_in_scope = 1 GROUP BY age ORDER BY age

questions.prompt: How many encounters have a predicted readmission risk above 20 percent?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(encounter_id) AS encounters_above_20_percent FROM hospital_readmissions WHERE predicted_readmission_risk > 0.2 AND predicted_readmission_risk_in_scope = 1
